# Novaflow — Glossary / Internal Jargon

- **The Monolith** — the legacy application being decommissioned by
  [Atlas Migration](../projects/atlas-migration.md).
- **The Grid** — internal nickname for the deploy/release tooling (Spinnaker + golden paths).
- **Golden path** — the paved, self-serve way to ship a service on
  [Atlas v2 Platform](../projects/atlas-v2-platform.md).
- **Cutover Council** — the weekly forum that approves each Atlas Migration wave.
- **Reliability Guild** — cross-team group driving [Meridian](../projects/meridian.md).
- **TTFV** — "time to first value," the north-star metric for
  [Onboarding Revamp](../projects/onboarding-revamp.md).
- **Run** — a single pipeline execution; the unit of usage-based billing.
- **Error budget** — the allowed unreliability under the 99.95% SLA before feature work pauses.
- **Falcon** — code name for a confidential initiative; use the code name only.
